project.name: Baobab ERP Outbox Bundle
project.description: Publishes a canonical event fact to baobab-app's transactional outbox (ADR-ERP-004/ADR-ERP-006) for a record this bundle's own events service resolved canonical identity for. Fire-after-commit, best-effort, matching org.nabhold.baobab.erp.events' own already-accepted eventual-consistency model (INV-ERP-EXT-011): iDempiere's own database and baobab's `baobab` schema are two separate databases, so this cannot be one atomic Postgres transaction with the iDempiere document post that triggered it -- only baobab-app's own insert into baobab.event_outbox is atomic, in its own database. See OutboxPublisher's own Javadoc for the full explanation.
